The structure of Mg12Ti4Mo2 (reduced formula Mg6Ti2Mo) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows Mg and Mo centers each with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Ti centers have 16 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Mg 12-vertex and Ti 16-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner-sharing among Ti polyhedra.
